verses.text_urhobo: Josẹf da gbanọ ọsẹ rọye ọ da vwẹ opharo te, ọ da viẹ, ọ da fiọnfiọn.
verses.text_romanized: josef da gbano ose roye o da vwe opharo te o da vie o da fionfion

verses.text_urhobo: Josẹf da kẹ idibo rọye rẹ ẹbo nẹ ayen vwẹ umwu pharọ orivwi rẹ ọsẹ rọye Ọtiọye na ẹbo na da pharọ orivwi rẹ Izrẹl,
verses.text_romanized: josef da ke idibo roye re ebo ne ayen vwe umwu pharo orivwi re ose roye otioye na ebo na da pharo orivwi re izrel

verses.text_urhobo: ẹdẹ ujuvẹ eruo, kidie ekuakua ra vwọ pharọ pha buebu. Ihwo rẹ Ijipt na da viẹ ẹdẹ ujorha gbẹ ihwe.
verses.text_romanized: ede ujuve eruo kidie ekuakua ra vwo pharo pha buebu ihwo re ijipt na da vie ede ujorha gbe ihwe

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹdẹ rẹ uvweri na ejobi vwọ ghwiẹ nu, Josẹf da ta kẹ ekru ri Fero nẹ, Ọ da dianẹ ivun mẹ vwerhe ovwan, gba ta, Me rẹ wẹ, ki Fero nyo nẹ,
verses.text_romanized: ede re uvweri na ejobi vwo ghwie nu josef da ta ke ekru ri fero ne o da diane ivun me vwerhe ovwan gba ta me re we ki fero nyo ne

verses.text_urhobo: Ọsẹ mẹ tanẹ, Mi duvwu iyori, tanẹ, Mi ghwẹ reọ; vwẹ evun rẹ ushi mẹ re Me tọn kẹ oma mẹ vwẹ otọ ri Kenan, Etiyin e shi vwe phihọ. Asakiephana gbe ju vwe ra, Me rẹ wẹ, re mi re shi ọsẹ mẹ, re mi rhivwi rhe.
verses.text_romanized: ose me tane mi duvwu iyori tane mi ghwe reo vwe evun re ushi me re me ton ke oma me vwe oto ri kenan etiyin e shi vwe phiho asakiephana gbe ju vwe ra me re we re mi re shi ose me re mi rhivwi rhe

verses.text_urhobo: Fero da kpahe kẹ, Yanran re shi ọsẹ wẹn, kirobo rọ tanẹ wo duvwu iyori kẹ ọye na.
verses.text_romanized: fero da kpahe ke yanran re shi ose wen kirobo ro tane wo duvwu iyori ke oye na

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye Josẹf da yanran re shi ọsẹ rọye, idibo ri Fero ejobi de nene yanran, kugbe ekpako rẹ Ijipt ejobi,
verses.text_romanized: koye josef da yanran re shi ose roye idibo ri fero ejobi de nene yanran kugbe ekpako re ijipt ejobi

verses.text_urhobo: etiọye ji te uwevwi ri Josẹf, emesẹ rọye, kugbe uwevwi rẹ ọsẹ rọye ejobi, jokpa rẹ imitete na ọvo, uchuru rayen, vẹ eranvwe rayen ọvo ri chekọ vwi Goshẹn.
verses.text_romanized: etioye ji te uwevwi ri josef emese roye kugbe uwevwi re ose roye ejobi jokpa re imitete na ovo uchuru rayen ve eranvwe rayen ovo ri cheko vwi goshen

verses.text_urhobo: Te idjighere rẹ ofovwi te iyesi vẹ otu re gua iyi nenire, usun grogro rọghọ rọghọ.
verses.text_romanized: te idjighere re ofovwi te iyesi ve otu re gua iyi nenire usun grogro rogho rogho

verses.text_urhobo: Rẹ ayen rhi vwo te uwevwi rẹ ewunye rẹ Atad, rọ abọ oboyi ri Jọdan, Etiyin ayen da viẹ oviẹ rode, oviẹ rẹ uvwerhe, o de muomahọ urhughwrẹ soso vwọ ke ọsẹ rọye.
verses.text_romanized: re ayen rhi vwo te uwevwi re ewunye re atad ro abo oboyi ri jodan etiyin ayen da vie ovie rode ovie re uvwerhe o de muomaho urhughwre soso vwo ke ose roye

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ ihwo rẹ otọ na, ihwo ri Kenan vwọ mrẹ omaemuohọ vwẹ uwevwi rẹ ewunye rẹ Atad, ayen da ta, Ọnana okpemu rode ri ru ihwo rẹ Ijipt na. Fiki rẹ ọtiọye na e vwo se asan na Abel-mizraim, ọ abọ oboyi ri Jọdan.
verses.text_romanized: oke re ihwo re oto na ihwo ri kenan vwo mre omaemuoho vwe uwevwi re ewunye re atad ayen da ta onana okpemu rode ri ru ihwo re ijipt na fiki re otioye na e vwo se asan na abel mizraim o abo oboyi ri jodan

verses.text_urhobo: Enẹ emọ rọye ru kẹ kirobo ro ji urhi kẹ ayen na,
verses.text_romanized: ene emo roye ru ke kirobo ro ji urhi ke ayen na

verses.text_urhobo: kidie emọ rọye muro rhe otọ ri Kenan, ayen de rhi sho phihọ ẹmwa rọ aghwa ri Mak-pela, rọ obọrhe ri Mamre, rẹ Ebraham dẹre kugbe udju mie Efrọn ohwo ri Hẹt, rọ dia ẹkẹn rẹ ogbẹ.
verses.text_romanized: kidie emo roye muro rhe oto ri kenan ayen de rhi sho phiho emwa ro aghwa ri mak pela ro oborhe ri mamre re ebraham dere kugbe udju mie efron ohwo ri het ro dia eken re ogbe

verses.text_urhobo: Ro vwo shi ọsẹ rọye nu. Josẹf de rhivwi kpo Ijipt vẹ emesẹ rọye kugbe ihwo ejobi ri nenire ra re shi ọsẹ rọye.
verses.text_romanized: ro vwo shi ose roye nu josef de rhivwi kpo ijipt ve emese roye kugbe ihwo ejobi ri nenire ra re shi ose roye

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ emesẹ ri Josẹf vwọ mrẹ nẹ ọsẹ rayen ghwure, ayen da ta, Ọke ọvo evun rẹ avwanre Me rhoma ri miovwo Josẹf, ọ Me rhe hwosa rẹ imwemwu ri Me ruro kẹ avwanre.
verses.text_romanized: oke re emese ri josef vwo mre ne ose rayen ghwure ayen da ta oke ovo evun re avwanre me rhoma ri miovwo josef o me rhe hwosa re imwemwu ri me ruro ke avwanre

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin ayen da vuẹ ovuẹ rhe Josẹf, tanẹ, Ọsẹ wẹn ji urhi nana ro ki ghwu.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin ayen da vue ovue rhe josef tane ose wen ji urhi nana ro ki ghwu

verses.text_urhobo: Ta ki Josẹf, Vwo ghovwo, Me rẹ we, ogbeku rẹ emesẹ wẹn kugbe umwemwu rayen kidie ayen ru imwemwu kpahe owẹ. Asakiephana, avwanre rẹ wẹ, vwo ghovwo ogbeku rẹ idibo rẹ Ọghẹnẹ rẹ ọsẹ wẹn. Josẹf da viẹ rẹ ayen vwọ vuẹ na.
verses.text_romanized: ta ki josef vwo ghovwo me re we ogbeku re emese wen kugbe umwemwu rayen kidie ayen ru imwemwu kpahe owe asakiephana avwanre re we vwo ghovwo ogbeku re idibo re oghene re ose wen josef da vie re ayen vwo vue na

verses.text_urhobo: Emesẹ rọye na ọvo da yan rhe ri shiguẹ kẹ, ayen da ta, Nighe, avwanre idibo wẹn.
verses.text_romanized: emese roye na ovo da yan rhe ri shigue ke ayen da ta nighe avwanre idibo wen

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo Josẹf da ta kẹ ayen, Wa djẹ oshọ-ọ fikiridie kẹ ẹdia rẹ Ọghẹnẹ mi epha?
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo josef da ta ke ayen wa dje osho o fikiridie ke edia re oghene mi epha

verses.text_urhobo: Vwọ kẹ ovwan, umwemwu we ru kpahe ovwẹ, ẹkẹvuọvo Ọghẹnẹ da rhẹriẹ umwemwu na vwọ erhuvwu kẹ vwẹ, o ruro rhe rere ihwo buebu vwọ rhọ, kirobo rọ epha nonẹ na.
verses.text_romanized: vwo ke ovwan umwemwu we ru kpahe ovwe ekevuovo oghene da rherie umwemwu na vwo erhuvwu ke vwe o ruro rhe rere ihwo buebu vwo rho kirobo ro epha none na

verses.text_urhobo: Ọtiọye na wa dje oshọ-ọ, Me je ghere ovwan vẹ emọ re ovwan. Kẹnẹ o phi udu phihọ ayen awọ o de bru ayen uche.
verses.text_romanized: otioye na wa dje osho o me je ghere ovwan ve emo re ovwan kene o phi udu phiho ayen awo o de bru ayen uche

verses.text_urhobo: Ọtiọye na Josẹf da dia otọ rẹ Ijipt, te ọye vẹ uwevwi rọye ejobi, Josẹf da dia ikpe ujori gbẹ ihwe.
verses.text_romanized: otioye na josef da dia oto re ijipt te oye ve uwevwi roye ejobi josef da dia ikpe ujori gbe ihwe

verses.text_urhobo: Josẹf da mrẹ ivwrọmọ rẹ erha rẹ Ifrem, ji te emọ ri Machir rẹ ọmọ ri Manasse re vwẹriẹ phihọ awọ ri Josẹf.
verses.text_romanized: josef da mre ivwromo re erha re ifrem ji te emo ri machir re omo ri manasse re vwerie phiho awo ri josef

verses.text_urhobo: Josẹf da ta kẹ emesẹ rọye, Mi che ghwu reọ, ẹkẹvuọvo Ọghẹnẹ che bru ovwan rhe, rọ da reyọ ovwan nẹ otọ nana vwo kpo otọ re veri kẹ Ebraham, Aizik, kugbe Jekọp.
verses.text_romanized: josef da ta ke emese roye mi che ghwu reo ekevuovo oghene che bru ovwan rhe ro da reyo ovwan ne oto nana vwo kpo oto re veri ke ebraham aizik kugbe jekop

verses.text_urhobo: Josẹf de tanẹ, emọ rẹ Izrẹl duvwu iyori, tanẹ, Ọghẹnẹ mrẹ ovwan, ovwan Me ghwa ibeku mẹ nẹ etinẹ.
verses.text_romanized: josef de tane emo re izrel duvwu iyori tane oghene mre ovwan ovwan me ghwa ibeku me ne etine

verses.text_urhobo: Josẹf de ghwu, rọ vwọ tọn ẹgbukpe ujori gbẹ ihwe nu, ayen da vwẹ umwu phare orivwi rọye, e de muo phihọ okọ vwẹ Ijipt.
verses.text_romanized: josef de ghwu ro vwo ton egbukpe ujori gbe ihwe nu ayen da vwe umwu phare orivwi roye e de muo phiho oko vwe ijipt

headings.text_urhobo: Josẹf ta uda phihọ Iniọvo Rọye Awọ
headings.text_romanized: josef ta uda phiho iniovo roye awo
